Minors (Alabama Dept. of Workforce poster, 2026; statute Ala. Code § 25-8-32 et seq. not fetched): 14-15 who work more than 5 hours continuously need a documented 30-minute break (not encoded, no minor-break type); 14-15 may not work where alcohol is served on premises. The 16-17 10 p.m./5 a.m. rule applies only before school days but is enforced every night of a school week (stricter); it also covers 18-year-olds enrolled in school (not encoded). Extra param key max_days_week.

rules.summary: While public schools are in session, 14- and 15-year-olds may work at most 3 hours on a school day, 8 on a non-school day, 18 hours and 6 days a week, 7 a.m.-7 p.m. on any day.

citation.title: Alabama Dept. of Workforce — Child Labor Law poster (Ala. Code §§ 25-8-32 to 63), 2026
citation.excerpt: No more than 3 hours on any school day No more than 8 hours on a non-school day No more than 6 days per week No more than 18 hours per week Not before 7am or after 7pm

rules.summary: While public schools are not in session, 14- and 15-year-olds may work at most 8 hours a day, 40 hours and 6 days a week, 7 a.m.-9 p.m.

citation.title: Alabama Dept. of Workforce — Child Labor Law poster (Ala. Code §§ 25-8-32 to 63), 2026
citation.excerpt: Schools are NOT in Session No more than 8 hours per day No more than 6 days per week No more than 40 hours per week Not before 7am or after 9pm each day

rules.summary: During school months, 16- and 17-year-olds enrolled in school may not work after 10 p.m. or before 5 a.m. on a night preceding a school day.

citation.title: Alabama Dept. of Workforce — Child Labor Law poster (Ala. Code §§ 25-8-32 to 63), 2026
citation.excerpt: Minors 16-17-18 years old who are enrolled in public or private school, may NOT work after 10pm or before 5am on an night preceding a school day.
